title: chaenorhinum reyesii
intro: Chaenorhinum reyesii, commonly known as the annual toadflax, is a flowering plant species in the figwort family, Scrophulariaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include its ability to provide relief from anxiety and insomnia due to its calming and sedative effects. The health benefits of Chaenorhinum reyesii are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and phenolic acids, which have been reported to exhibit antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. However, more research is needed to confirm the full scope of its therapeutic actions and bioactive constituents.
